pressure_note: P/bar as printed; the paper does not say whether absolute or gauge, nor whether it is the total pressure; the experiment is a water-saturated gas stream in a bubble column at the stated pressure

value.what: water content of the gas-rich phase, printed in percent (mole basis implied by the symbol x; not spelled out in the paper); value = printed x 0.01

skip_rows.reason: gas label rows C1H4, C2H6, C3H8

notes: Three side-by-side blocks (C1H4, C2H6, C3H8) stacked left to right with one label row per block. Data rows 1-21 methane, 23-41 ethane, 43-63 propane (0-based over all data rows incl. label rows). At 383.15 K and 413.15 K the propane rows may lie in the liquid-propane region (text mentions part of the data at LLE); the table does not mark this. The label 'C1H4' is printed so (typographic).
